author: WenjingKangIntel
title: CMake configure fails - MODULE_LIBRARY type plugins cannot be linked
signature: target of type MODULE LIBRARY may not be linked into another target in ov generate plugins hpp|Code Issue
key_errors: CMake Error at cmake/developer_package/plugins/plugins.cmake:275 (target_link_libraries): Target "openvino_auto_plugin" of type MODULE_LIBRARY may not be linked into another target. One may link only to INTERFACE, OBJECT, STATIC or SHARED libraries, or to executables with the ENABLE_EXPORTS property set.
root_cause: CMake configure fails for both arm64 and x64 Android builds. The ov_target_link_plugins macro in cmake/developer_package/plugins/plugins.cmake:275 attempts to link MODULE_LIBRARY targets (openvino_auto_plugin, openvino_auto_batch_plugin, openvino_hetero_plugin, openvino_intel_cpu_plugin, openvino_intel_gpu_plugin) into another target. CMake prohibits linking MODULE_LIBRARY types. This is a pre-existing Android build issue unrelated to the NPU PR changes which only touch src/plugins/intel_npu/.
reproduction_steps: Configure OpenVINO for Android target with the same CMake flags used in the CI job.
recommended_actions: Investigate cmake/developer_package/plugins/plugins.cmake:275 to determine if MODULE_LIBRARY targets should be SHARED instead for Android builds
Check if a recent CMake change altered plugin library type for Android
prevention_strategies: Ensure Android CMake configuration is validated in precommit CI before merge queue builds.
historical_context: First occurrence of this specific CMake MODULE_LIBRARY linking error. The Android build configuration appears to have regressed - possibly from a recent cmake/ change.
